mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair letrozole metabolism and increase toxicity risk, plus both drugs can cause hepatic dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and liver enzymes closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider dose adjustment of letrozole if renal impairment develops; use liposomal amphotericin B formulation if possible to minimize nephrotoxicity.
